name: Certified Information Privacy Professional / United States

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded US privacy-law recognition and accreditation support professional jurisdictional advisory knowledge; open entry and multiple-choice testing do not establish experience, technical delivery or Japanese-law coverage.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded accreditation and US privacy-law hiring demand make this a useful professional privacy knowledge filter. Zero experience and a multiple-choice exam mean it should not substitute for demonstrated legal application or technical security delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded US privacy-law breadth is useful for cross-border work, but it requires no experience and uses a multiple-choice exam. For this EU consulting perspective, the evidence supports associate legal-domain knowledge below the professional hints.
